name: mcpClient
description: Connects to a named MCP server declared in .cfconfig.json under mcpServers, using the same shape an editor's client config uses so a block can be pasted across without translation. Returns a client handle identical to the one from mcpConnect(). Resolving a name requires serve mode with a loaded configuration; in a CLI run with no configuration loaded, use mcpConnect() with an explicit command or url instead.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of a server declared under mcpServers in .cfconfig.json.
